title: useSocket: make reconnect behaviour configurable
summary: useSocket's reconnect now defaults to false; the existing callers (CanvasBoard, ChatRoomClient) pass no options and silently lose auto-reconnect.
why: After any drop (server deploy, network blip) the socket is never re-opened: socket becomes undefined while loading stays false, CanvasBoard's effect tears down its handlers and the board stops syncing and accepting input with no indication.

title: ui: rename submit state "loading" to "pending"
summary: Union member "loading" removed from the exported SubmitState type in packages/ui; the sign-in and sign-up pages still call setState("loading").
why: apps/web fails to typecheck (TS2345 in signin/page.tsx:16 and signup/page.tsx:16). Even if forced through, the button would get data-state="loading", which no CSS rule matches any more, so the spinner never shows.

title: Store queue data under a dedicated Redis key prefix
summary: Producer Queue gets prefix 'recall'; the Worker in worker.ts is still constructed without a prefix, so it listens on the default 'bull' keys.
why: Jobs are written to recall:content-processing:* but the worker polls bull:content-processing:*, so no job is ever picked up: every saved item stays 'pending' forever, with no summary, tags or embedding.

title: canvas: hide the background grid while viewing history
summary: Optional trailing parameter with a behaviour-preserving default; one caller opts in.
why: Clean control: default keeps existing behaviour; the one caller that passes the option does so intentionally.

title: Clear the search box with Escape
summary: Small dependency-free UI feature.
why: Clean control.

title: Share the chat context column list between both lookups
summary: Pure refactor: duplicated select projection extracted to a constant.
why: Clean control: identical columns, identical queries.

title: Return null from generateSummaryAndTags when the reply can't be parsed
summary: Return type of generateSummaryAndTags widened to AISummaryResult | null; worker.ts and the repair script dereference the result without a null check.
why: Backend typecheck gains TS18047 errors in worker.ts and repair-blocked-metadata.ts. At runtime any unparseable model reply makes aiResult.summary throw, so the job fails and retries (re-calling the model) and the item ends up 'failed' instead of saved.

title: web: move useSocket next to the other client libs
summary: File move with every import (including the moved file's own relative import) updated.
why: Clean control: no importer left pointing at hooks/useSocket.

title: Search: accept an optional limit parameter
summary: Range check uses && instead of || (limit < 1 && limit > 10), which can never be true.
why: Wrong comparison: out-of-range values pass validation. limit=0 returns no results, negative limits silently drop results from the end via slice(0, -n), and nothing ever gets the documented 400.

title: Return the existing card when a saved link is added again
summary: Check-then-act: SELECT for an existing (user, link) row, then a slow metadata fetch, then INSERT, with no unique constraint or transaction.
why: Race: two concurrent saves of the same link (double submit, two tabs, input bar plus modal) both pass the check during the multi-second fetchMetadata window and both insert, so the duplicates the change is meant to prevent still occur and are each processed.

title: Distinguish failed op-log loads from empty boards
summary: fetchOperations return type widened to CanvasOp[] | null; CanvasBoard's loadOps spreads and folds the result without a null check.
why: CanvasBoard.tsx fails to typecheck (TS2488 at 271, TS2345 at 272). At runtime a failed load makes `[...ops]` throw inside the un-awaited loadOps(), so `hydrating` never becomes false and the board never renders; live ops pile up in opBuffer.

title: http: serve the op log at /rooms/:roomId/operations
summary: http-backend route moved from /operations/:roomId to /rooms/:roomId/operations; the web client's fetchOperations (and the replay script) still request /operations/:roomId.
why: The client's GET now hits a non-existent route (404), fetchOperations logs and returns [], so every board opens empty: persisted history is never hydrated even though ops are still stored.

title: Document hybridSearch parameters and lead with the query
summary: First two parameters of hybridSearch (both string) swapped to (query, userId); the route handler and both search scripts still pass (userId, query).
why: No type error (both strings). At runtime the user's query text is used as the user id in `user_id = $1` (Postgres rejects it as an invalid uuid, so /api/v1/search returns 500) and the uuid is used as the FTS query.

title: Let callers set the metadata fetch timeout
summary: Optional parameter with a behaviour-preserving default; one caller opts in.
why: Clean control: default equals the previous constant.

title: Chat stream: rename the citations event to sources
summary: SSE event type and payload key renamed on both the server and its only client.
why: Clean control: producer (index.ts) and consumer (AskAIPanel.tsx) change together.

title: ws: send chat broadcasts as chat_message with a timestamp
summary: Message type renamed on both the sending and the receiving side.
why: Clean control: the only consumer of chat broadcasts (ChatRoomClient) is updated in the same commit.

title: Report embedding API failures instead of returning null
summary: generateEmbedding now throws on API/network failure where it used to return null; callers rely on null to degrade gracefully and don't catch.
why: During any OpenAI outage or quota exhaustion: the worker throws after generating the summary, so jobs retry (re-calling the summariser) and end 'failed' instead of saving without an embedding; /api/v1/search returns 500 instead of keyword-only results; /api/v1/chat fails instead of falling back to recent items.

title: Namespace the auth token in localStorage
summary: authStore writes/reads the token under 'recall:token'; lib/api.ts and AskAIPanel still read/remove localStorage 'token'.
why: After sign-in the axios interceptor finds no 'token', sends requests without Authorization, gets 401 and redirects to /signin, so users can never get past login (existing sessions keep working only until they log out). Ask AI also sends an empty Authorization header.

title: backend-common: read JWT secret from AUTH_JWT_SECRET
summary: packages/backend-common/src/config.ts now reads process.env.AUTH_JWT_SECRET; every .env.example and both load scripts still set/read JWT_SECRET.
why: Both backends import the config at startup and now throw 'AUTH_JWT_SECRET is not set' in any environment configured from the templates or the existing Railway variables (JWT_SECRET), so neither service boots.

title: canvas: rename stateAtSeq to shapesAtSeq
summary: Rename of an exported function with every reference updated.
why: Clean control: all references (canvas.ts, CanvasBoard.tsx, bench/README-replay.md) renamed; no behaviour change.

title: Add server-to-client message schemas to common types
summary: Exported WsMessageSchema renamed to ClientMessageSchema in packages/common; apps/ws-backend still imports and calls WsMessageSchema.
why: ws-backend no longer compiles (TS2724 at index.ts:5). At runtime the import is undefined, so WsMessageSchema.safeParse throws on every incoming frame (an unhandled rejection in the async message handler) and no join/chat/op message is processed.

title: canvas: share polyline segment iteration
summary: someSegment() iterates i < points.length and passes points[i + 1] as the second point, so the last call gets undefined.
why: Off-by-one: on the last iteration b is undefined and distToSegment reads b.x, throwing a TypeError. Any select-tool click that doesn't hit an earlier segment of a pencil stroke throws in the mousedown handler; polylineLength() always throws.

title: http: add DELETE /room/:slug for room admins
summary: prisma.room.delete(...) is not awaited inside the try block.
why: Missing await: the handler always answers 204 immediately; a P2025 (not found / not the admin) rejection escapes the try/catch as an unhandled promise rejection, so the 404 path is dead and, under Node's default unhandled-rejection mode, any user can crash http-backend by deleting a room they don't own.

title: Card: replace readOnly flag with a variant prop
summary: Exported CardProps field readOnly replaced by variant; pages/shared.tsx still passes readOnly.
why: Frontend typecheck fails at shared.tsx:81 (TS2322). At runtime readOnly is ignored and variant defaults to "owner", so the public shared page shows delete buttons to anonymous visitors; clicking one sends an unauthenticated DELETE, gets 401, and bounces the visitor to /signin.

title: Make text extraction cancellable
summary: Required parameter `signal: AbortSignal` added to exported extractText(); worker.ts and scripts/repair-blocked-metadata.ts still call it with four arguments.
why: Backend typecheck gains TS2554 in worker.ts:44 and repair-blocked-metadata.ts:117. At runtime signal is undefined, so `signal.aborted` throws for every non-cached item: every content job fails and retries until it is marked failed.

title: canvas: express zoom limits in percent and add zoom presets
summary: MIN_SCALE/MAX_SCALE change units from a scale factor (0.1..8) to percent (10..800); CanvasBoard still clamps the camera scale factor against them.
why: Every zoom path in CanvasBoard (zoom buttons, ctrl/cmd+wheel, Fit) clamps cam.scale to at least 10, i.e. 1000% zoom, so any zoom action jumps to an unusable zoom level and zooming out is impossible.

title: ws: namespace per-socket replies as op:ack / op:error
summary: ws-backend renames the ack frame type from 'op_ack' to 'op:ack'; the web client (and the ws load script) still match on "op_ack".
why: CanvasBoard never matches an ack, so locally emitted ops keep seq undefined forever: they are excluded from currentMaxSeq() and treated as seq 0 by stateAtSeq, so time-travel shows your own edits at the very start of history. bench-ws counts zero acks.

title: Ask AI: render bold, inline code and citations in answers
summary: Model output, saved-page titles and saved links are interpolated into an HTML string without escaping and rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
why: Unsafe HTML building (XSS): a saved page whose og:title or extracted text contains markup (or prompt-injects the model into emitting it) runs script in the user's session, e.g. in the answer or a quote-breaking title attribute, and can read the token from localStorage.

title: canvas: deselect when another user edits the selected shape
summary: New selection check reads data.payload.id for every incoming op, but DELETE ops carry payload: null.
why: Unhandled null: for every remote DELETE, data.payload.id throws a TypeError that the surrounding try/catch swallows before the op is pushed or applied, so remote deletes are silently dropped on all other clients (and the old delete-deselect behaviour is gone).

title: Move search under /api/v1/content/search
summary: Server route renamed from /api/v1/search to /api/v1/content/search; the frontend's useSearch still calls /api/v1/search.
why: Every search from the dashboard now gets a 404; useSearch surfaces an error/empty results, so search is dead in the UI while the server route works.
